description: This is a CMake module script used to locate and set up the bcm_host library for building projects that depend on it. It defines variables indicating the presence of bcm_host and sets up the target for linking.

methods.name: find_package
methods.description: Locates a package configuration or provides a fallback mechanism for dependencies.

methods.name: pkg_check_modules
methods.description: Checks for the existence of specified pkg-config modules.

methods.name: find_library
methods.description: Attempts to locate a library by name in specified hints.

methods.name: set_target_properties
methods.description: Sets properties for a target, such as location and compile options.

methods.name: add_library
methods.description: Creates a library target from given source files or as an imported target.

methods.name: mark_as_advanced
methods.description: Marks variables as advanced to hide them in GUIs and simplify configuration.
